title: High-Protein Chicken & Quinoa
process: Cook the quinoa according to package instructions. Season chicken breast and grill until fully cooked. Steam broccoli. Divide into meal prep containers.

title: Overnight Recovery Berry Oats
process: Mix oats, protein powder, and almond milk in a jar. Top with fresh berries. Refrigerate overnight and enjoy cold.

title: Roasted Sweet Potato & Black Bean Bowls
process: Dice and roast sweet potato at 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes. Warm black beans. Assemble bowls and top with fresh avocado and a squeeze of lime.

title: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini Noodles
process: Form turkey into meatballs and bake for 20 minutes. Spiralize zucchini into noodles. Simmer meatballs in marinara sauce and serve over raw or lightly sauteed zoodles.

title: Greek Lemon Herb Salmon & Asparagus
process: Place salmon and trimmed asparagus on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Protein Recovery Smoothie
process: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend on high until smooth and creamy. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad Prep
process: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Chop cucumber and tomatoes. Toss all ingredients in a bowl with olive oil and lemon dressing. Divide into portions.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry Meal Prep
process: Slice steak thinly and stir-fry in a hot pan. Add broccoli, ginger, and a splash of soy sauce. Cook until broccoli is tender-crisp. Serve with brown rice.

title: Chia Seed & Almond Milk Pudding
process: Whisk chia seeds, almond milk, vanilla, and a dash of maple syrup in a container. Let sit for 5 minutes, whisk again, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Spiced Lentil and Spinach Soup
process: Simmer lentils in vegetable broth with cumin and spices until soft (about 30 minutes). Stir in fresh spinach at the very end until wilted.

title: Tofu and Edamame Power Bowl
process: Press and cube tofu, then pan-fry until golden. Steam edamame. Serve tofu and edamame over a bed of brown rice and drizzle with sesame dressing.

title: Green Spinach & Whey Protein Smoothie
process: Add water, spinach, protein powder, and banana to a blender. Blend until completely smooth. Add ice if desired.

title: Baked Garlic Herb Chicken Breast
process: Rub chicken breast with minced garlic, rosemary, and olive oil. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25-30 minutes until juices run clear.

title: Roasted Cauliflower & Chickpea Tins
process: Chop cauliflower and toss with drained chickpeas, olive oil, and paprika. Roast at 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes. Drizzle with tahini before eating.

title: Shrimp and Brown Rice Meal Prep
process: Cook brown rice. Sauté sliced bell peppers and shrimp seasoned with Cajun spices until shrimp are pink and opaque. Mix and store.

title: Cottage Cheese & Pineapple Bowl
process: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl. Top with fresh pineapple chunks and sprinkle with chia seeds for added texture.

title: Turkey and Avocado Wrap Prep
process: Lay out the wrap. Mash avocado and spread it evenly. Layer with fresh spinach and turkey breast. Roll tightly and wrap in foil for storage.

title: Chocolate Banana Recovery Shake
process: Place the frozen banana, milk, cocoa powder, and protein powder into a blender. Blend until smooth and pour into a shaker bottle.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Bacon Hash
process: Halve the Brussels sprouts and dice the onion. Chop turkey bacon. Roast everything on a baking sheet at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes, tossing halfway.

title: Egg White and Spinach Frittata Muffins
process: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spray a muffin tin. Fill cups halfway with spinach and tomatoes. Pour egg whites over the veggies and bake for 15-20 minutes.
